typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Db_CAE_RPT_UTIL as string (),
	Db_cm_CC_MOBILE as string (),
	Id_CAE_RPT_UTIL as string (),
	Id_cm_CC_MOBILE as string (),
	Pw_CAE_RPT_UTIL as string (),
	Pw_cm_CC_MOBILE as string (),
	Src_CAE_RPT_UTIL as string (),
	Src_cm_CC_MOBILE as string (),
	v_bol_fileExist as boolean (),
	v_fileURL as string (),
	v_form_id as integer (),
	v_inputFolder as string (),
	v_inputSpreadsheetName as string (),
	v_source_id as integer (),
	v_update_date as timestamp (),
	v_user_id as integer ()
}

source(output(
		SubscriberID as string,
		{Contact Date} as string,
		Contact as string,
		Note as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource	source(output(
		SBSB_ID as string,
		CID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select DISTINCT subscriber_id  as SBSB_ID, CAST(cid AS CHAR(10)) as CID FROM CKOLTP.MEMBER_COVERAGE WHERE group_id LIKE \'NJMC%\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
ExcelSource derive({Note type} = toString('Other'),
		{Other Notetype} = toString('EPSDT-QM'),
		{Contact Type} = toString('LETTER OUT'),
		{Completed By} = toString(' ')) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(SubscriberID == SBSB_ID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(isMatch()) ~> FilterLookup
FilterLookup unpivot(output(
		ConceptName as string,
		ConceptValue as string
	),
	ungroupBy(SubscriberID,
		CID
	),
	lateral: false,
	ignoreNullPivots: false) ~> Unpivot
Unpivot derive(USER_ID = $v_user_id,
		SOURCE_ID = $v_source_id,
		STATUS = toString('P'),
		FORM_ID = 500655,
		UPDATE_DATE = $v_update_date,
		CONCEPT_ID = iif(iif(iif(iif(iif(iif(iif(ConceptName == 'Contact Date', '521938', ConceptName == 'Contact'), '521942', ConceptName == 'Contact Type'), '521941', ConceptName == 'Completed By'), '521944', ConceptName == 'Note'), '522368', ConceptName == 'Note type'), '528633', ConceptName == 'Other Notetype'), '522434', '99999'),
		TEXT = 'NJ EPSDT Missing Services Load from file',
		CONCEPT_VALUE_CODE = iif(iif(iif(iif(ConceptName == 'Contact', replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(upper(replace(ConceptValue, toString(' '), toString(''))), toString('MEMBER,'), toString('1,')), toString('FOSTER PARENT'), toString('6,')), toString('SPOUSE'), toString('3,')), toString('GUARDIAN/CAREGIVER'), toString('4,')), toString('PCP'), toString('5,')), toString('PARENT'), toString('2,')), toString('DYFS STAFF'), toString('8,')), toString('DD CASE MANAGER'), toString('8,')), toString('OTHER'), toString('9,')), toString(',,'), toString(',')), ConceptName == 'Contact Type'), '6,', ConceptName == 'Note type'), '8,', ConceptName == 'Completed By'), 'Mr. Outreach User', trim(ConceptValue))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of UPDATE_DATE} = UPDATE_DATE,
		{Copy of FORM_ID} = FORM_ID,
		{Copy of SOURCE_ID} = SOURCE_ID,
		{Copy of CID} = CID,
		{Copy of STATUS} = STATUS,
		{Copy of CONCEPT_ID} = toInteger(CONCEPT_ID),
		{Copy of USER_ID} = USER_ID,
		{Copy of TEXT} = toString(TEXT),
		{Copy of CONCEPT_VALUE_CODE} = toString(CONCEPT_VALUE_CODE)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		CONCEPT_ID as integer,
		UPDATE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SOURCE as integer,
		USER_ID as integer,
		TRANSFER_STATUS as string,
		TEXT as string,
		CONCEPT_VALUE as string,
		FORM_ID as integer,
		CID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CONCEPT_ID = {Copy of CONCEPT_ID},
		UPDATE_DATE = {Copy of UPDATE_DATE},
		SOURCE = {Copy of SOURCE_ID},
		USER_ID = {Copy of USER_ID},
		TRANSFER_STATUS = {Copy of STATUS},
		TEXT = {Copy of TEXT},
		CONCEPT_VALUE = {Copy of CONCEPT_VALUE_CODE},
		FORM_ID = {Copy of FORM_ID},
		CID = {Copy of CID})) ~> CPMWBFORM
